capstone.title: Your First Phone Portfolio
capstone.brief: Build a portfolio of ten photos taken only with your phone: two portraits, two product or food photos, two street or event photos, two flat lays or outfits, and two free-choice photos. Edit them on your phone and present them as a set.
checks: Ten photos in total, all from a phone
Two product or food photos included
Two street or event photos included
Two flat lays or outfits included
All photos edited on the phone
Photos saved in one portfolio folder
deliverables: A short caption for each photo
A note on your favorite style
A plan for your next photo project
